# Frozen synthetic dialect corpus v1

These hand-authored transcripts specify Gobstopper's admitted offline dialect,
not live provider versions or resume acceptance. They contain no captured user data.
The manifest independently names physical items, live context, elidable byte counts,
linkage, findings, and the only JSON pointers a full elision may change. Expected
values are authored from this contract, not generated by a production parser.
SHA-256 pins make any fixture update explicit in review.

`cargo test -p gobstopper-adapters --test dialects --locked frozen_corpus_oracles`
checks the frozen oracles. `scripts/check-dialects.py` checks corpus completeness
and hashes, then runs the bounded adversarial driver with its declared seed.
The driver also runs as an ordinary adapter integration test. Named regressions
in `tests/dialects.rs` remain independent of Hegel's seed database.
